def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    dividers = image_patch.find("divider")
    
    if not cars or not dividers:
        return cars + dividers
    
    central_divider = min(dividers, key=lambda d: abs(d.horizontal_center - image_patch.width / 2))
    near_cars = [car for car in cars if distance(car, central_divider) < 0.5]
    
    return near_cars
